content.title: Denver Mile High City Unveiled: Top Reasons to Explore
content.text: Location, Location, Location! Flora House is minutes from everything Denver has to offer. Great restaurants, cafes, theaters, salons, saloons, shops and gyms are all just a few blocks away. We put together a few of our favorite nearby restaurant and activity suggestions, as well as a few options that are well worth a daytrip, in our Flora Faves list.We are proud to offer complimentary General Admission to the Denver Botanic Gardens for our guests, just a few blocks away and a beautiful experience in any season. Flora House sits between beautiful Cheesman Park and Denver’s expansive City Park which is also home to the Denver Zoo and the Museum of Nature and Science. Both parks are within 6 blocks’ walking distance from our front door. Many of Denver’s best known neighborhoods are just minutes away by bike, scooter or ride, including Cherry Creek, Wash Park, Larimer Square, RiNo, Union Station and LoHi. If you'd like to visit some of our world class Ski Resorts but don't have a vehicle, you can hop on the SNOWSTANG bus service running Saturdays & Sundays to your choice of several resorts & mountain towns. And don’t forget world famous Red Rocks Amphitheatre, open daily for visitors and hosting live music for much of the year. **PRO TIP**The Concert Shuttle for shows at Red Rocks picks up just 1/2 block from us, at the Illegal Petes on Colfax! Flora House Guests receive discounted shuttle pricing, so book your room and then reserve your spot to the show!
